scope: Same fixed System32 UCRT loader as existing rotation adapter. Opt-in sealed SystemUcrtCrowdMath borrowed view lazily binds atan2f from that module; no second loader, injectable success interface, CRT recovery or original-game runtime validation.

binding.note: Disk API-set relationship only; original loaded CRT host and numeric outputs unobserved.

contract.binary_signature: cdecl float atan2f(float y,float x), explicit R4; prototyped x64 XMM0=y, XMM1=x, XMM0=result
contract.crowd_inputs: atan2 y and x finite normal-or-zero; crowd sin/cos finite normal-or-zero [-4,9] radians. Caller consumes Field Unknown before passing scalars; this is not a replacement for engine caller integration.
contract.output: Finite normal-or-zero; unsupported special inputs rejected before call, unsupported outputs stop after real native call.
contract.rotation_unchanged: Acos [-1,1], sin/cos [-4,4]. Rotation-only opens still resolve exactly prior4 exports; Crowd adds atan2f on same owner.
contract.floating_control: Same _controlfp_s(out word,0,0) query only, default nearest/masked/preserved-denormal contract before/after; no writes.
contract.module_identity: Same absolute C:/Windows/System32/ucrtbase.dll; existing file hash/version/size, actual module path and export owner checks. Existing disk identity is not a memory-image hash.
contract.lifetime: One sealed Crowd view per owner; no public construction or virtual math injection. Dispose owner invalidates view.

angle_provenance.schedule: Three rings ESI=0..2, each seven samples. Initial angle=atan2f(Z,X)+(ESI&1)*half; add step after each sample. Float atan result roughly [-pi,pi], maximum sampled angle about8.977. Own [-4,9] boundary covers this selected evidence and is not a native range clamp.

planned_tests.reference: Independent elementary/quadrant atan2 values, signed-zero own-profile requirements, 30-term sine/cosine Taylor corpus up to9 radians with4 ULP tolerance; candidate angle schedule from saved bytes; gates, owner/export identity, disposal.
planned_tests.affected_regression: Unchanged old11 scenarios/96 assertions/33 calls rerun against revised shared loader because source changed. No old rotation-composition or other suite.

official_sources.supports: float atan2f(float y,float x), radians, quadrants and zero cases
Prototyped float arguments in positional XMM0/XMM1 and result XMM0
Existing zero-mask read-only FP control query
Math is approximate and platform dependent; no original runtime or cross-host bit equivalence
